svg.title: Connective tissue diseases: the signature feature sorts lupus and antiphospholipid syndrome, Sjogren's syndrome, inflammatory myositis and systemic sclerosis; each column gives presentation, the antibodies and tests in order, and treatment, with Raynaud's and lupus care below

svg.text: ANA negative → lupus highly unlikely · ANA positive alone proves nothing (common in the healthy)
